nodes.name: Daily 07:00 GST
nodes.notes: Scans the sheet each morning and sends anything approved and not yet scheduled to Buffer.

parameters.jsonBody: {"query":"query GetScheduledPosts { posts(input: {organizationId: \"694486bc467d109517b74823\", filter: {status: [scheduled] } } ) { edges { node { id dueAt } } } }"}

nodes.name: Check Buffer Headroom
nodes.notes: Buffer's free plan holds max 10 scheduled posts. This counts what is already there so we never send more than fits.

nodes.name: Pick Posts To Send
nodes.notes: Approved + not already in Buffer. Undated rows get the next free slot (10:00 / 13:00, Mon-Sat), written back to the sheet. DUPLICATE GUARD: skips any row whose Post_ID or post text has already been sent, or appears twice in the sheet - the write-back only updates the first matching row, so duplicates would otherwise re-post every run.

nodes.name: Has Image?
nodes.notes: Whatever is in Image_URL gets attached. Blank means a text post. The workflow never makes images.

nodes.name: Mark Done In Sheet
nodes.notes: Writes back the slot the workflow chose, plus the Buffer ID that stops it ever being sent twice.

nodes.name: Summary
nodes.notes: Reads the loop's done output, which holds every row written back. Referencing 'Read Buffer Result' here only ever returned the LAST iteration, which made a 7-post run report as 1.
